title: Sound Like a Native foundation 1: A map at home
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: Mira el mapa que está en la mesa.
sentences.en: Look at the map that is on the table.

sentences.target: Mi mamá mira la moto desde la casa.
sentences.en: My mom looks at the motorcycle from the house.

sentences.target: La moto es de mi amigo Memo.
sentences.en: The motorcycle belongs to my friend Memo.

sentences.target: Memo toma una foto de la luna.
sentences.en: Memo takes a photo of the moon.

sentences.target: Mañana miramos el mapa antes de salir.
sentences.en: Tomorrow we look at the map before leaving.

title: Sound Like a Native foundation 2: A morning with Memo
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: Memo prepara la maleta para mañana.
sentences.en: Memo packs the suitcase for tomorrow.

sentences.target: Lleva una moneda pequeña en la mano.
sentences.en: He carries a small coin in his hand.

sentences.target: Su mamá pone música en la cocina.
sentences.en: His mom plays music in the kitchen.

sentences.target: Memo mira la maleta una vez más.
sentences.en: Memo looks at the suitcase one more time.

sentences.target: Por la mañana toma el mismo camino.
sentences.en: In the morning he takes the same route.

title: Sound Like a Native foundation 3: Buying fruit
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: Pablo compra una papa y un poco de pan.
sentences.en: Pablo buys a potato and a little bread.

sentences.target: La papa cuesta un peso en esta oferta.
sentences.en: The potato costs one peso in this offer.

sentences.target: Una bolsa cae al piso junto a la puerta.
sentences.en: A bag falls to the floor next to the door.

sentences.target: Pablo la recoge y pide jugo puro.
sentences.en: Pablo picks it up and asks for pure juice.

sentences.target: Después prepara la comida para su paseo.
sentences.en: Then he prepares the food for his outing.

title: Sound Like a Native foundation 4: Tea with Teresa
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: Teresa tiene tiempo para preparar té.
sentences.en: Teresa has time to make tea.

sentences.target: Pone una taza junto a la tetera.
sentences.en: She puts a cup next to the teapot.

sentences.target: El tubo del filtro está limpio.
sentences.en: The filter tube is clean.

sentences.target: Su tía llega y toma la taza.
sentences.en: Her aunt arrives and takes the cup.

sentences.target: Teresa toma té mientras escucha a su tía.
sentences.en: Teresa drinks tea while she listens to her aunt.

title: Sound Like a Native foundation 5: A note beside the lamp
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: Nora deja una nota al lado de la lámpara.
sentences.en: Nora leaves a note beside the lamp.

sentences.target: La nota dice que Luis llega esta noche.
sentences.en: The note says that Luis arrives tonight.

sentences.target: Luis mira una nube desde la ventana.
sentences.en: Luis looks at a cloud from the window.

sentences.target: Luego ve la luna sobre la casa.
sentences.en: Then he sees the moon above the house.

sentences.target: Nora enciende la lámpara y lee la nota.
sentences.en: Nora turns on the lamp and reads the note.

title: Sound Like a Native foundation 6: Soup and a photograph
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: La familia se sienta en la sala.
sentences.en: The family sits in the living room.

sentences.target: Sofía pone una silla cerca de la mesa.
sentences.en: Sofía puts a chair near the table.

sentences.target: Su hermano sirve sopa para todos.
sentences.en: Her brother serves soup for everyone.

sentences.target: Felipe trae una foto de la familia.
sentences.en: Felipe brings a photograph of the family.

sentences.target: Al final todos miran la foto y sonríen.
sentences.en: At the end everyone looks at the photograph and smiles.

title: Sound Like a Native foundation 7: A small café order
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: Quiero una copa de agua y un poco de queso.
sentences.en: I would like a glass of water and a little cheese.

sentences.target: El queso cuesta quince pesos.
sentences.en: The cheese costs fifteen pesos.

sentences.target: Compro queso para comer en casa.
sentences.en: I buy cheese to eat at home.

sentences.target: Cerca de la mesa hay una cuna pequeña.
sentences.en: Near the table there is a small crib.

sentences.target: Después camino a casa con mi compra.
sentences.en: Then I walk home with my shopping.

title: Sound Like a Native foundation 8: A guitar in the garden
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: El gato duerme cerca de la guitarra.
sentences.en: The cat sleeps near the guitar.

sentences.target: Una gota de agua cae sobre la guía.
sentences.en: A drop of water falls on the guide.

sentences.target: Guardo la guía antes de salir al jardín.
sentences.en: I put away the guide before going into the garden.

sentences.target: Mi amigo toca la guitarra con mucho gusto.
sentences.en: My friend plays the guitar with great pleasure.

sentences.target: Luego el gato camina hacia la puerta.
sentences.en: Then the cat walks toward the door.

title: Sound Like a Native foundation 9: A child and a small backpack
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: El niño prepara la mochila para mañana.
sentences.en: The child packs the backpack for tomorrow.

sentences.target: Su hermana guarda una muñeca pequeña.
sentences.en: His sister puts away a small doll.

sentences.target: La mamá sirve leche en una taza.
sentences.en: The mom serves milk in a cup.

sentences.target: El niño lleva la mochila hasta la puerta.
sentences.en: The child carries the backpack to the door.

sentences.target: Mañana todos caminan juntos a la escuela.
sentences.en: Tomorrow everyone walks to school together.

title: Sound Like a Native foundation 10: A first clear message
subtitle: Latin American Spanish · English support

sentences.target: Mi amigo quiere ir al parque por la tarde.
sentences.en: My friend wants to go to the park in the afternoon.

sentences.target: Miro el mapa y explico el camino.
sentences.en: I look at the map and explain the route.

sentences.target: Llevamos comida y una botella de agua.
sentences.en: We take food and a bottle of water.

sentences.target: Caminamos juntos hasta la entrada del parque.
sentences.en: We walk together to the park entrance.

sentences.target: Después mi amigo repite el plan sin mirar el mapa.
sentences.en: Then my friend repeats the plan without looking at the map.
